verdict.rationale: Convex's docs say it 'provides a database, a place to write your server functions, and client libraries,' with project creation via `npm create convex@latest`, a cloud dev deployment that the CLI pushes to, and transactional server-side mutators. Client libraries are listed for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte and others, in JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin and Rust, and functions can also be called over public HTTP endpoints. Missing for 10: concrete docs on client SDK read/write APIs and on server-side SDK clients (beyond server functions and HTTP), and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end provisioning-to-read/write flow.
